sections.title: Quick Reference: Core Dice Mechanics and Once-Per-Arc Special Abilities
sections.text:
Core Dice Mechanics
Rolling Dice: Roll a Dice Pool which consists of an Attribute and any relevant bonuses. Any Successes (5s or 6s rolled) beyond the Check (difficulty) are Net Successes.
Dice Roll Results: Just one net success is a Near Hit, and victory comes with an unexpected consequence; zero net successes is a Near Miss, and failure comes with a small benefit.
Once-Per-Arc Special Abilities
I'm Really Feeling It: Add one Attribute to Initiative roll, and gain 6 Special Points.
It's Reyn Time: Guarantee roll success.
The Heronop Special: Turn failed roll into Near Miss.

sections.title: Quick Reference: Combat Turns, Movement and End of Turn Reminders
sections.text:
Combat Turns
On Your Turn: On your turn in combat, you may Move, perform an Action (any one dice roll; most often an Attack), and freely change the direction you're Facing.
Movement
Move from one orthogonal, adjacent square to another. Diagonal squares are 2 squares apart. Movement can be split before and after an action.
Non-Blades: Move a number of squares per turn equal to your Movement trait.
Blades: You can freely move about the squares in your current Radius and change radii a number of times equal to your Movement trait. Take -1 in third radius; roll at half (rounded up) and move one square per turn outside radii.
Distance: If you don't attack, take double movement.
Radius Changes: If Bearer moves, choose nearest square in previous radius or stay in place, changing radii. If Bearer is moved, stay in place.
Facing: You may face any cardinal direction. Choose a direction at the end of your turn.
End of Turn Reminders
- Choose Facing.
- If Blade, choose a square to stay in.
- Gain a Special Point if your basic attack or art hit.
- Turn Cooldown Dice 1 lower. 1s turned are removed; art is ready.
- Move Turn Order Token from top of turn order list to bottom.

sections.title: Quick Reference: Attacking and Defending, Special Attack Levels, Party Size Rules
sections.text:
Attacking and Defending
Attack: Name a target within your attack's Range (distance in squares) and perform a standard dice roll to attack. Face your target; they Face you after the attack.
Defend: Standard dice roll to defend. Turn to Face attacker.
Basic Attack: Range = Basic Attack Range trait. Typically no bonuses. Successful attacks grant one Special Point.
Art: Range = 1 + Range +1 Art tags. Target might be an Area of Effect. Potency +1 and Positional tags grant bonus dice. Beneficial effects apply regardless of range and success. Arts have Cooldowns. Successful attacks grant one Special Point.
Special Attack: Range = anywhere. Higher levels are Area of Effect. Each special increases the Special Level of the next one. Expend Special Level x 6 Special Points to use. Dice pools use Ideas; roll unopposed. Applies one Elemental Effect from elements aligned with the idea.
Special Attack Levels
1: Cost 6. Target one enemy; roll chosen idea; apply one aligned elem. effect.
2: Cost 12. Split damage among any enemies in a 3x3 area; you and your partner each roll your chosen idea; apply one aligned elem. effect to all hit.
3: Cost 18. Split among 5x5 area; each choose an idea to roll; apply one elem. effect from either idea to all hit. Resets Special Level to 1.
Party Size Special Attack Rules
1 Team: Specials 1 and 2 do not consume Special Points.
2 Teams: One team receives 6 Special Points when the other uses a Level 2 Special.
3+ Teams: No changes.

sections.title: Quick Reference: Art Tag Effects (Fundamentals, Area of Effect, Reactions, Positionals)
sections.text:
Art Tag Effects. Legend: * = has important, complex mechanics; (+) = has a beneficial effect with a duration; (-) = has a detrimental effect with a duration.
Fundamentals
Potency +1 (max 5): +1 to attack.
Healing Potion: One ally heals net successes.
Cooldown -1 (max 2): Start cooldown Die 1 lower.
Area of Effect
Circle Attack (max 2): Target all enemies in a 3x3 area; lv. 2 for 5x5 area.
Line Attack: Target all enemies in a straight line 5 + Bonus Range long.
Reactions
* (-) Break: Hit target is Broken, vulnerable to Topple and Launch, until your next turn. Can be extended by whole turn cycles.
* (-) Topple: Requires and removes Break. Target cannot move or attack until your next turn. They can defend, but failed attacks are Near Hits. Take an action to un-topple an adjacent ally. Cannot be extended.
* Launch: Requires and removes Break. Target is pushed net successes squares away. Object collision deals damage = squares from stopping. Hit combatant takes damage = squares from stopping. If no object collision, target moves back in the turn order one place.
Stagger: Hit target moves back in the turn order one place.
Rush (max 2): Movement +1.
Positionals
Side Advantage (Bearers): Attack from side for +1.
Rear Advantage (Bearers): Attack from behind for +2.
Pincer Attack (Blades): Gain +2 against target in lower radius.

sections.title: Quick Reference: Art Tag Effects (Elemental Effects and Other Tags)
sections.text:
Elemental Effects
Using one requires appropriate Elemental Affinity. Pick one of these for every Special Attack. Maximum effect duration is 6.
* Unique Elemental Effect: choose any one effect corresponding to one of your affinities:
(-) Fire (Burning Blade): Target takes 1 damage per turn for net successes turns.
(-) Water (Arts Seal): Target cannot use arts and do not lower cooldowns on their next turn.
(+) Wind (Blustering Gale): Ally gets +1 defense for net successes turns.
(-) Ice (Freezing Force): Target cannot move next turn. Frozen Bearer = Blade cannot change radii.
(+) Earth (Cradling Earth): Ally removes and blocks all detrimental effects until your next turn.
Electricity (Electrifying Burst): Target moves back in the turn order or ally moves forward in the turn order one place.
(+) Light (Blade of Light): Ally Bearer gains +2 range for net successes turns, or ally Blade moves freely among all radii with no penalties during their next turn.
(-) Dark (Shadow Manipulation): Redirect enemy attacks to chosen ally for net successes turns.
Invigorating Steam (bravery, fire or water): One ally uses one art one turn sooner.
(-) Bitter Snowstorm (truth, wind or ice): Target takes -1 movement (min 0) and attack range (min 1) for net successes turns.
(+) Counter Spike (compassion, earth or electricity): Anyone who attacks you takes 1 damage back for net successes turns.
(-) Blinding Eclipse (justice, light or dark): Target takes -1 to attack and defense rolls until after your next turn.
Other Tags
Precise Attack: Detrimental effects do not hit allies.
Range +1 (max 5): +1 attack range.
